```python
class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows=[]
        self.notes={}
        self.loading=False
        self.error=None
        self.seq=0
        self.active_request_id=None

    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq+=1
        self.active_request_id=self.seq
        self.error=None
        return self.active_request_id

    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        if self.active_request_id is None or request_id != self.active_request_id:
            return False
        self.rows=rows
        self.active_request_id=None
        return True

    def copy_rows(self):
        return self.rows[:]

    def get_loading(self):
        return self.loading

    def get_notes(self):
        return self.notes.copy()
```

from view import View

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.error = "old error"
    rid = v.begin("q1")
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.active_request_id == rid

def test_finish_only_latest():
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin("q1")
    rid2 = v.begin("q2")
    assert v.finish(rid1, [1,2]) == False
    assert v.finish(rid2, [3,4]) == True
    assert v.active_request_id is None

def test_finish_stale_id():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("q1")
    assert v.finish(rid + 1, [1]) == False

def test_finish_duplicate():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("q1")
    assert v.finish(rid, [1]) == True
    assert v.finish(rid, [2]) == False

def test_copy_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [1,2,3])
    c = v.copy_rows()
    assert c == [1,2,3]
    c.append(4)
    assert v.rows == [1,2,3]

def test_get_loading():
    v = View()
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    v.loading = True
    assert v.get_loading() == True

def test_get_notes():
    v = View()
    v.notes["j1"] = "note1"
    v.notes["j2"] = "note2"
    c = v.get_notes()
    assert c == {"j1": "note1", "j2": "note2"}
    c["j1"] = "changed"
    assert v.notes["j1"] == "note1"

def test_notes_persist_across_requests():
    v = View()
    v.notes["j1"] = "note1"
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [1])
    v.begin("q2")
    v.finish(2, [2])
    assert v.notes["j1"] == "note1"

def test_loading_not_cleared_by_finish():
    v = View()
    v.loading = True
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [1])
    assert v.get_loading() == True

def test_begin_preserves_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [1,2])
    v.begin("q2")
    assert v.rows == [1,2]

def test_finish_replaces_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [1,2])
    v.begin("q2")
    v.finish(2, [3,4])
    assert v.rows == [3,4]

def test_finish_invalid_id_returns_false():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    assert v.finish(999, [1]) == False
    assert v.rows == []

def test_finish_no_active_request():
    v = View()
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) == False
